name: Scallop Aguachile With Jalapeño, Cucumber, and Avocado

ingredients.name: jalapeño peppers, stemmed and seeded and roughly chopped
seeded and thinly sliced cucumber half-moons, divided
loosely packed cilantro leaves, tender stems roughly chopped

instructions.primary_message: Arrange scallops in an even layer on a large plate and sprinkle all over with salt. Cover with plastic and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 2 hours.

Meanwhile, blend jalapeños with water in a blender or with an immersion blender until thoroughly blended. Add diced cucumber and blend until pureed. Add lime juice and cilantro and blend until cilantro is finely chopped. Season with salt and pepper.
In a mixing bowl, toss scallops with jalapeño-lime marinade, onion, and remaining cucumber half-moons. Season once more with salt and pepper and serve right away with tostadas and avocado.

schema_metadata.keywords: aguachile, ceviche, easy, Latin American, scallop, seafood

description: If you love ceviche, then Mexico's aguachile is for you. Traditionally made with raw shrimp, lime juice, chilies, cucumber, and onion, it's served immediately while still totally raw, unlike most other ceviche recipes. In this variation, sweet raw scallops are tossed with lime juice, jalapeño chilies, cucumber, and red onion, then served with tostadas and avocado (and if you like, beer or tequila).
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 10 min to 2 hr 30 min.

Optional or for serving: Tostadas and avocado, for serving

Optional substitutions: Sea salt → kosher salt
author: Daniel Gritzer
